mapper.select: SELECT notify_enabled, notify_system, notify_interaction, notify_cert FROM user_setting WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_setting (user_id, notify_enabled, notify_system, notify_interaction, notify_cert) VALUES (#{userId}, #{notifyEnabled}, #{notifySystem}, #{notifyInteraction}, #{notifyCert}) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE notify_enabled = new.notify_enabled, notify_system = new.notify_system, notify_interaction = new.notify_interaction, notify_cert = new.notify_cert
